outcome: Total amount of opioids prescribed (measured in morphine milligram equivalents - MMEs) within 3 days of discharge from surgery
cohort: Patients aged 0 to 21 years who underwent surgical procedures and had commercial or Medicaid insurance claims in the Merative MarketScan databases.
finding: Pediatric surgical opioid prescribing is highly concentrated among a small number of procedures, with Tonsillectomy and/or adenoidectomy being the most significant contributor across both analyzed age groups.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery accounted for 7.8% of opioid MMEs dispensed post-surgery among patients aged 12 to 21 years, ranking among the top three procedures for opioid prescribing in this older adolescent/young adult group.
